Professional Summary
Cloud-focused DevOps engineer with hands-on experience designing and operating Azure-native CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and containerized applications. Proven record of reducing deployment lead time, stabilizing releases, and automating repetitive operational tasks using Terraform, PowerShell, and container orchestration. Comfortable collaborating with development and SRE teams to deliver scalable, observable platforms.

Technical Skills
Microsoft Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, PowerShell, React, TS, Confluence, Linux

Work Experience

Azure DevOps Engineer, Zentrix Labs (Sep 2025 - Present)
- Implemented container build pipelines and image lifecycle using Docker, reducing image build time by 35% and standardizing base images across projects.
- Automated environment provisioning and configuration tasks with PowerShell scripts integrated into release pipelines, cutting manual setup errors by 60%.
- Designed release promotion flows in Azure DevOps to orchestrate blue/green deployments for microservices running on Kubernetes clusters.

Cloud Engineer, Swiggy (Mar 2023 - Aug 2025)
- Developed and maintained infrastructure-as-code modules in Terraform to provision Azure resources for high-traffic services, improving reproducibility and reducing onboarding time for new environments.
- Automated routine maintenance and deployment tasks with PowerShell runbooks, enabling zero-downtime maintenance windows for critical services.
- Containerized legacy services into Docker images and helped migrate them onto Kubernetes, achieving a 40% improvement in resource utilization.

Azure DevOps Engineer, Pixelwave Studios (Jun 2022 - Feb 2023)
- Created Terraform modules to manage multi-tenant Azure infrastructure, enforcing tagging and policy guardrails across subscriptions.
- Collaborated on Kubernetes cluster configuration and deployment strategies for game backend services, improving rollout consistency.
- Built CI pipelines in Azure DevOps to validate infrastructure changes and application manifests prior to production deployments.

UI Engineer, Medisure (Feb 2019 - May 2022)
- Implemented interactive front-end features using React and TS for patient portal applications, improving user task completion rates.
- Worked with backend and DevOps teams to containerize frontend applications using Docker for consistent staging and production behavior.
- Documented component usage and release notes in Confluence to streamline handoffs between design and engineering teams.

Education
B.Tech, Electronics, NIT Trichy
